craft_notes: Sthāyin: opening wonder (maṅgala flash; FIRST VERSE — sets the house voice: vocative-pair invocation, dash-suspension, end-weight self; owner verdict required). Sanskrit-first: saṃsphuratāt = benedictive 3sg (may-it-FLASH — flash, not mere shine). Abhinavagupta frame: the invocation performs sādhāraṇīkaraṇa in reverse — the universal Heart summoned into this book, this reader (‘for me’ last). Rows: 7 (Mother…Father pair kept — direct address opens the work), 1 (mama end-weighted — ‘for me’ closes; the invocator's self last), 5 (bank: hymn-opening tread for śloka-source). Close: ‘for me’. Rejected: ‘shine’ for flash — killed: saṃsphuratāt is burst-flash; splitting Mother/Father across lines — killed: yāmala is one breath, the pair IS the doctrine. Read aloud: MO-ther of STAIN-less ART … FIVE-faced FA-ther … may the HEART flash-FORTH … FOR-me.

lines: Mother of stainless art, of new great making, full-bodied one —
five-faced Father, splendor hidden — may the Heart flash forth, deathless kin beyond all, for me.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vimalakalāśrayābhinavasṛṣṭimahā jananī bharitatanuś ca pañcamukhaguptarucir janakaḥ | tadubhayayāmalasphuritabhāvavisargamayaṃ hṛdayam anuttarāmṛtakulaṃ mama saṃsphuratāt

reads_against.argmap: Whom invoke, and what flash forth? → Mother-Father flash forth the Heart; the book promises plain essence; the lineage-lotus is to be gathered for worship.
c1_essence: Mother of stainless art and new creation, five-faced Father hidden in splendor: may their yamal-burst Heart, deathless kin beyond all, flash forth; the unplungeable ocean condensed to plain essence — hear it; the heart-lotus uncontracted by the master's feet gathered for worship.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta-śānta of invocation settling into teaching
